value.rationale: The crown graph is a canonical dense bipartite family one perfect matching away from K_{n,n}. The theorem gives both the exact Italian domination number and a complete minimizer classification/count over an infinite family, including genuine small-order transitions. This directly advances the recent counting direction for Italian dominating functions rather than merely recomputing one numerical instance.
